title: Preview and production surfaces live at distinct URLs both discoverable from the manifest
asA: operator investigating a change or an incident
iWant: one command to print the preview URLs and the production URL for the Worker
soThat: the dashboard is not a step on any triage path

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Deploy Adapter's `deploy status` (or equivalent named verb on the adapter surface) returns a structured object naming the current production URL, the preview alias URL, and the currently-serving version id.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an operator on a machine authenticated to the deploy vendor
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator invokes the adapter's `deploy status` verb
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a structured object whose fields include `productionUrl`, `previewAliasUrl`, and `currentlyServingVersionId`; every field is populated

acceptanceCriteria.description: The preview alias URL and the production URL are never equal; a manifest whose production route resolves to the same host as the preview alias URL is refused by the adapter with a stable-coded error.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `wrangler.toml` whose production route stanza names the same host as the preview alias URL
acceptanceCriteria.then: the load throws a `DEPLOY_URL_COLLAPSED` error naming both URLs; no deploy verb accepts the manifest

acceptanceCriteria.description: A request to the production URL and a request to the preview alias URL immediately after an upload but before a promote resolve to different version ids in their health-probe responses.
acceptanceCriteria.given: production serving version P and an uploaded-not-promoted version W behind preview alias A
acceptanceCriteria.when: a health probe hits the production URL and a second health probe hits A
acceptanceCriteria.then: the production response body carries `versionSha` of P and the preview response body carries `versionSha` of W; the two values are not equal
